Emphasis on Drug Interactions for Improving Medication Safety
Wang Aijun，Yao Linqing，Zhang Xin( Gansu Provincial Second People' s Hospital，Lanzhou，Gansu，China 730000 )Abstract: Objective To investigate the relationship between the drug interactions and medication safety． Methods To explore the clinical medication safety from the aspects of the classification of drug interactions and how to reduce the adverse interaction． Results The adverse drug interactions were reduced from the aspects of implementing the individualized administration，paying attention to the package insert of the drug，emphasis on the medication of the high － risk populations with drug interaction occurrence and the drugs prone to the drug interactions． Conclusion Emphasis on drug interactions is extremely important to improve the medical quality and the effective combination medication．药物相互作用是指 2 种或 2 种以上药物同时或之后以相同或不同的给药途径给予而使药物作用效应发生变化，从机理上主要分为理化相互作用药代动力学相互作用和药效学相互作用药物相互作用的方式很多，临床表现为作用加强或减弱。
